title: A week of every train in Chicago
description:
A week of every train in Chicago, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the Chicago city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Red Line, Blue Line, Brown Line, Green Line, Orange Line and Pink Line, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 148 trains, Monday at 8:10 am.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable and leave out Columbus Day (October 12). October 31 is left out because the clocks change that night. Metra ran a reduced timetable on October 24, so that Saturday is left out.
